title: Counterfactual Transport across Heterogeneous Sites with Observational, Interventional, and Counterfactual Data
banked_reason: Broad local failure completeness is false on sparse compatibility fibers, and explicit paired-SCM extraction requires a new sample-point, representation, decoding, and correctness architecture; the sound achieved contribution is subfield tier (6.8), below the field floor.
gap_reasons: The delivered local recursion is proved sound but not complete: FACE_NOT_IDENTIFIED certifies variation only in an outer row relaxation and need not imply broad-model nonidentification.
The nonidentification branch returns QE range and endpoint formulas but expressly does not construct paired SCMs, missing the proposal's promised explicit fixed-alphabet paired-model certificate.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived a sound source-labelled district recursion, exact saturated-fiber local results, and an exact global sparse-canonical QE fallback with range, evidence, and acquisition results. The proposed broad local converse is false because the row face can strictly outer-relax the true sparse/cross-district compatibility projection. Returning explicit paired SCM objects would require new semialgebraic sampling, representation, decoding, and correctness machinery beyond the attested quantifier-elimination result, so the maximized sound paper remains subfield-tier.
tldr: Heterogeneous sites may supply observational, interventional, and genuine Layer-3 partial-copy laws.  Certified extraction yields local district rows, while exact graph-compatible canonical fibers retain every cross-district complete-menu equation on the original observed alphabets.  The hybrid procedure returns an allowed rational functional when the local recursion identifies the query and otherwise gives an exact real-semialgebraic range or an evidence-status rejection.  Global regime-block acquisition may itself establish conditional definability: only the full acquired fiber must be uniformly positive, every candidate subset is screened exactly, and exhaustive search returns all least-cost subsets preserving the full-menu arm set.  The local LP remains the cheaper special case with a checked positive evidence bound on its base face, and the Boolean pushforward witness shows that neither local nor global arm elimination is submodular in general.
gap: CTFTR transports conditional counterfactuals from heterogeneous Layer-1/2 inputs, CTFIDU+ identifies from Layer-3 inputs in one causal specification, and Park--Lee pruning uses graph-based action classes or fixed transported bounds. None derives an exact source-menu certificate or a sign-regime boundary for the order of conditional Layer-3 arms.
fill: The project proves fixed-alphabet realization of the compatible face, gives certified typed extraction and an inductive DCTFTR semantics, replaces global row span by an active-face criterion, derives sharp primal--dual arm-order certificates, verifies the complete binary phase boundary, and poses minimum-cost regime-block acquisition before asking whether the construction survives multi-district gluing.
